paragraphs.text: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus in behalf of you Gentiles,--
paragraphs.original: Τούτου χάριν ἐγὼ Παῦλος ὁ δέσμιος τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν—
paragraphs.translit: Toutou charin egō Paulos ho desmios tou Christou Iēsou hyper hymōn tōn ethnōn—

paragraphs.text: if so be that ye have heard of the dispensation of that grace of God which was given me to you-ward;
paragraphs.original: εἴ γε ἠκούσατε τὴν οἰκονομίαν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς·
paragraphs.translit: ei ge ēkousate tēn oikonomian tēs charitos tou theou tēs dotheisēs moi eis hymas·

paragraphs.text: how that by revelation was made known unto me the mystery, as I wrote before in few words,
paragraphs.original: κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν ἐγνωρίσθη μοι τὸ μυστήριον, καθὼς προέγραψα ἐν ὀλίγῳ,
paragraphs.translit: kata apokalypsin egnōristhē moi to mystērion, kathōs proegrapsa en oligō,

paragraphs.text: whereby, when ye read, ye can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;
paragraphs.original: πρὸς ὃ δύνασθε ἀναγινώσκοντες νοῆσαι τὴν σύνεσίν μου ἐν τῷ μυστηρίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: pros ho dynasthe anaginōskontes noēsai tēn synesin mou en tō mystēriō tou Christou,

paragraphs.text: which in other generation was not made known unto the sons of men, as it hath now been revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;
paragraphs.original: ὃ ἑτέραις γενεαῖς οὐκ ἐγνωρίσθη τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὡς νῦν ἀπεκαλύφθη τοῖς ἁγίοις ἀποστόλοις αὐτοῦ καὶ προφήταις ἐν πνεύματι,
paragraphs.translit: ho heterais geneais ouk egnōristhē tois hyiois tōn anthrōpōn hōs nyn apekalyphthē tois hagiois apostolois autou kai prophētais en pneumati,

paragraphs.text: [to wit], that the Gentiles are fellow-heirs, and fellow-members of the body, and fellow-partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel,
paragraphs.original: εἶναι τὰ ἔθνη συγκληρονόμα καὶ σύσσωμα καὶ συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,
paragraphs.translit: einai ta ethnē synklēronoma kai syssōma kai symmetocha tēs epangelias en Christō Iēsou dia tou euangeliou,

paragraphs.text: whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
paragraphs.original: οὗ ἐγενήθην διάκονος κατὰ τὴν δωρεὰν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ—
paragraphs.translit: hou egenēthēn diakonos kata tēn dōrean tēs charitos tou theou tēs dotheisēs moi kata tēn energeian tēs dynameōs autou—

paragraphs.text: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach unto the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
paragraphs.original: ἐμοὶ τῷ ἐλαχιστοτέρῳ πάντων ἁγίων ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις αὕτη— τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαι τὸ ἀνεξιχνίαστον πλοῦτος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: emoi tō elachistoterō pantōn hagiōn edothē hē charis hautē— tois ethnesin euangelisasthai to anexichniaston ploutos tou Christou,

paragraphs.text: and to make all men see what is the dispensation of the mystery which for ages hath been hid in God who created all things;
paragraphs.original: καὶ φωτίσαι πάντας τίς ἡ οἰκονομία τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ ἀποκεκρυμμένου ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων ἐν τῷ θεῷ τῷ τὰ πάντα κτίσαντι,
paragraphs.translit: kai phōtisai pantas tis hē oikonomia tou mystēriou tou apokekrymmenou apo tōn aiōnōn en tō theō tō ta panta ktisanti,

paragraphs.text: to the intent that now unto the principalities and the powers in the heavenly [places] might be made known through the church the manifold wisdom of God,
paragraphs.original: ἵνα γνωρισθῇ νῦν ταῖς ἀρχαῖς καὶ ταῖς ἐξουσίαις ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις διὰ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἡ πολυποίκιλος σοφία τοῦ θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: hina gnōristhē nyn tais archais kai tais exousiais en tois epouraniois dia tēs ekklēsias hē polypoikilos sophia tou theou,

paragraphs.text: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
paragraphs.original: κατὰ πρόθεσιν τῶν αἰώνων ἣν ἐποίησεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν,
paragraphs.translit: kata prothesin tōn aiōnōn hēn epoiēsen en tō Christō Iēsou tō kyriō hēmōn,

paragraphs.text: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
paragraphs.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ προσαγωγὴν ἐν πεποιθήσει διὰ τῆς πίστεως αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: en hō echomen tēn parrēsian kai prosagōgēn en pepoithēsei dia tēs pisteōs autou.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore I ask that ye may not faint at my tribulations for you, which are your glory.
paragraphs.original: διὸ αἰτοῦμαι μὴ ἐγκακεῖν ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσίν μου ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ἥτις ἐστὶν δόξα ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: dio aitoumai mē enkakein en tais thlipsesin mou hyper hymōn, hētis estin doxa hymōn.

paragraphs.text: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father,
paragraphs.original: Τούτου χάριν κάμπτω τὰ γόνατά μου πρὸς τὸν πατέρα,
paragraphs.translit: Toutou charin kamptō ta gonata mou pros ton patera,

paragraphs.text: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
paragraphs.original: ἐξ οὗ πᾶσα πατριὰ ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς ὀνομάζεται,
paragraphs.translit: ex hou pasa patria en ouranois kai epi gēs onomazetai,

paragraphs.text: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that ye may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;
paragraphs.original: ἵνα δῷ ὑμῖν κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ δυνάμει κραταιωθῆναι διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν ἔσω ἄνθρωπον,
paragraphs.translit: hina dō hymin kata to ploutos tēs doxēs autou dynamei krataiōthēnai dia tou pneumatos autou eis ton esō anthrōpon,

paragraphs.text: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
paragraphs.original: κατοικῆσαι τὸν Χριστὸν διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν ἐν ἀγάπῃ· ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ τεθεμελιωμένοι,
paragraphs.translit: katoikēsai ton Christon dia tēs pisteōs en tais kardiais hymōn en agapē· errizōmenoi kai tethemeliōmenoi,

paragraphs.text: may be strong to apprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,
paragraphs.original: ἵνα ἐξισχύσητε καταλαβέσθαι σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις τί τὸ πλάτος καὶ μῆκος καὶ ὕψος καὶ βάθος,
paragraphs.translit: hina exischysēte katalabesthai syn pasin tois hagiois ti to platos kai mēkos kai hypsos kai bathos,

paragraphs.text: and to know the love of Christ which passeth knowledge, that ye may be filled unto all the fulness of God.
paragraphs.original: γνῶναί τε τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν τῆς γνώσεως ἀγάπην τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἵνα πληρωθῆτε εἰς πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: gnōnai te tēn hyperballousan tēs gnōseōs agapēn tou Christou, hina plērōthēte eis pan to plērōma tou theou.

paragraphs.text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
paragraphs.original: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑπὲρ πάντα ποιῆσαι ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ὧν αἰτούμεθα ἢ νοοῦμεν κατὰ τὴν δύναμιν τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἡμῖν,
paragraphs.translit: Tō de dynamenō hyper panta poiēsai hyperekperissou hōn aitoumetha ē nooumen kata tēn dynamin tēn energoumenēn en hēmin,

paragraphs.text: unto him [be] the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus unto all generations for ever and ever. Amen.
paragraphs.original: αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: autō hē doxa en tē ekklēsia kai en Christō Iēsou eis pasas tas geneas tou aiōnos tōn aiōnōn· amēn.
